The ssh-config entry's ProxyCommand (run by ssh, not by hand).

Usage: termag ssh-proxy [--wake [--timeout <seconds>]] termag-<box> <port>

--wake starts a stopped or hibernated box (one still stopping or hibernating once it
has), as `termag box start --wait` does, then connects. Progress goes to stderr.
--timeout bounds each wait (default 600).

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
